gui.better_rei.tree.title: Recipe Tree - %s
gui.better_rei.tree.hint: Left-click icon -> REI recipes / right-click -> usages · click to expand · amounts follow the first recipe per level, spending the inventory top-down · gold "make Nx" marks the counted route · wheel or drag the scrollbar · ESC closes
gui.better_rei.tree.reloaded: REI data reloaded, the recipe tree refreshed itself (your expansion state and scroll position were kept)
gui.better_rei.tree.expanding: Expanding everything frame by frame, so the UI stays smooth... collapse any row or press Collapse All to stop it
gui.better_rei.tree.no_entries: This display has no entries to show
message.better_rei.tree.no_item: Recipe tree: no item to query - hold an item, or hover one, then press Ctrl+R.

message.better_rei.tree.wrong_rei: Better REI: the recipe tree is built for REI %s (found %s) and has disabled itself. REI itself is unaffected; wait for a newer Better REI release.

gui.better_rei.tree.filter.title: Checked = shown
gui.better_rei.tree.filter.empty: No categories yet (REI is still loading, reopen in a moment)
